accepted_risks.risk: Peer authentication (build option, default off): listener admission is serialised through one pending setup slot; a caller that names a pinned key identifier and never sends its third message delays other admissions on that listener until the connection timeout or retry limit.
accepted_risks.decision: Owner accepted shipping the experimental, default-off 0.3.4 profile with this recorded as a documented limit.

not_decided_for_this_release: The residual risks accepted for 0.3.3 in acceptance-0.3.3.json (macOS identity-rendezvous timeout, intermittent OBS desktop reconnect) have not been re-decided for 0.3.4. No correction for either is part of this product.
scope: Only the risk listed above. All other required release gates must pass.
